internal.title: Incident Summary: High Latency in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 10:48 UTC on 2026-11-08, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion as the root cause, with CPU utilization reaching 98%, causing the service latency to spike to 1.8 seconds at the 95th percentile. Related services, including recommendation and product-catalog, also showed elevated latency contributing to the issue.

The mitigation involved disabling the high CPU flag on the ad service at 11:08 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery with latency returning to normal levels (0.12 seconds p95). The incident was resolved shortly after.

Key timeline:
- 10:48:24 Alert received
- 11:08:05 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion
- 11:08:13 Flag disabled and recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 10:48 and 11:08 UTC on November 8, 2026, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service. The issue was caused by high resource usage, which has now been resolved. Service performance has returned to normal. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
